name: Jean Alesi swaps the prancing horse for Williams
description: At the end of 1990, Jean Alesi had two career-defining offers on the table: Ferrari or Williams. In reality, he chose the Prancing Horse... but what if he had chosen differently?

it.name: Jean Alesi lascia il Cavallino per la Williams
it.description: Alla fine del 1990, Jean Alesi aveva sul tavolo due offerte decisive per la carriera: Ferrari o Williams. Nella realtà scelse il Cavallino... ma se avesse scelto diversamente?
